message: 猫に小判、サリーにご飯

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, Student Council! Haven't you guys been slacking off lately!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't just blurt out something so rude out of nowhere.」

name: Sally
message: 「Last night! I was like――」

name: Sally
message: 「Sniff, sniff. Something smells delicious~~」

name: Sally
message: 「And ended up wandering onto the academy grounds!」

name: Sally
message: 「And to my total shock, there was a whole pack of demons gathered there!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wasn't it just the members of the Delicious Food Takers?」

name: Sally
message: 「Right! I was totally sure they'd snuck ahead to eat good food without me again, except……」

name: Misa
message: 「Let me guess, the punchline is that there wasn't any left for you.」

name: Sally
message: 「Wrong-o! It wasn't everyone from the Delicious Food Squad--they were completely different demons!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Different demons……?」

name: Sally
message: 「Instead of going 'Eee!', they cried 'Meow!'!」

name: Ria
message: 「So that was supposed to be a cry\s02」

name: Sally
message: 「And they were super strong, too!! Even the almighty, invincible Sally-chan couldn't win against those numbers.」

name: Sally
message: 「So I tucked my tail between my legs and ran away\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ho-ho~. You mean this tail right here? Squeeze, squeeze.」

name: Sally
message: 「H-Hey, stop that! D-Don't touch it, hyah, nooo!」

name: Misa
message: 「So you're saying demons separate from your comrades have snuck onto the grounds?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah! And they were eating something super tasty!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Weren't they just scrounging through Prier's leftovers or somethin'?」

name: Sally
message: 「Which is why! The plan is to drive away those strong-looking demons so I can have the leftovers!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's a made-to-order shop--there's no way they'd have leftovers.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sniff, sniff. I smell another incident brewing, Madame President.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...! To think something like that was happening behind my back...」

name: Helena
message: 「A useless Student Council is fired!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Misa
message: 「This is a grave situation. We can't let it slide.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A new species discovered... I'm getting excited!」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe I let my guard down a little too much after Kirafes ended.」

name: Misa
message: 「We're going to tighten things up a bit from here on.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Bring it on, I say--」
